papers.title: Process Gas Infiltration in Inconel 718 Samples during SLM Processing
papers.abstract: RTeJournal - Fachforum fur Rapid Technologie, Vol. 2016, Iss. 1 - Argon infiltration is a well-known problem of hot isostatic pressed components. Thus, the argon content is one quality attribute which is measured after a hot isostatic pressing (HIP) process. Since the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process takes place under an inert argon atmosphere; it is imaginable that argon is entrapped in the component after SLM processing. Despite using optimized process parameters, defects like pores and shrink holes cannot be completely avoided. Especially, pores could be filled with process gas during the building process. Argon filled pores would clearly affect the mechanical properties. The present paper takes a closer look at the porosity in Inconel 718 samples, which were generated by means of SLM. Furthermore, the argon content of the powder feedstock, of samples made by means of SLM, of samples which were hot isostatic pressed after the SLM process, and of conventionally manufactured samples were measured and compared. The results showed an increased argon content in the Inconel 718 samples after SLM processing compared to conventional manufactured samples.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM过程中氩气渗入问题，未涉及任何生物医学植入物或力学性能匹配内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on argon infiltration during SLM processing of Inconel 718, with no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing, and no biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM加工后氩气渗入对Inconel 718样品性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 测量不同加工状态样品的氩含量并进行比较分析。
summary_zh.result: SLM加工后样品氩含量高于传统制造样品。
summary_zh.validation: 通过氩含量测量对比验证工艺气体渗入现象。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the extent of argon infiltration in Inconel 718 samples produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Measured argon content in powder feedstock, as-built SLM samples, HIP-treated samples, and conventionally manufactured samples.
summary_en.result: SLM-processed samples exhibited increased argon content compared to conventionally manufactured ones.
summary_en.validation: Comparative argon content measurements across different processing conditions.

papers.title: Management of Vancouver B2 peri-prosthetic femoral fractures: following the evidence
papers.abstract: This study by Shi (1) is one in a series of studies that have demonstrated the effectiveness of long-stem revision arthroplasty supplemented with cerclage for the management of Vancouver B2 peri-prosthetic femur fractures after total hip arthroplasty (THA). No randomized trials exist addressing the optimal management of such fractures; instead, management guidelines have been developed based upon accumulation of level IV evidence. This study reported the outcomes of 14 patients after a mean of 5.2 years. All patients had clinical and radiological fracture union within 6.5 months and no adverse events were reported. A mean Harris hip score of 83 points is above what has been typically reported for revision THA (2).

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文仅讨论临床骨折管理，无任何生物力学分析或假体应力遮挡评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper provides no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估长柄翻修加环扎治疗B2型假体周围骨折的效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾14例患者平均5.2年随访结果
summary_zh.result: 所有患者骨折愈合，无不良事件，Harris评分平均83分

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the outcomes of long-stem revision arthroplasty with cerclage for Vancouver B2 peri-prosthetic femoral fractures.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study of 14 patients with a mean follow-up of 5.2 years.
summary_en.result: All patients achieved clinical and radiological union within 6.5 months with no adverse events; mean Harris hip score was 83.
